reviews.title: Listen Podcast no longer working
reviews.text: I used to listen to the readings because as a lector I need to get pronunciation correct. I redownloaded the app and it still doesn’t work.

reviews.title: I love this app, but…
reviews.text: I tried to download it again after not having it for a year. When I did, I couldn’t access a lot of the features- daily prayer, Vatican documents, etc. I really want to use it again, I hope it gets resolved soon.

reviews.title: VERY disappointed
reviews.text: I started using this app a few months ago but I can no longer use it because of the AI slop they have started to use. There are all sorts of ethical dilemmas that the developer should be aware of that go along with ai. Also ive seen some other people post some stuff about the app having blasphemous stuff on the daily verse option. I am very disappointed:(( ☹️

reviews.title: The Latin mass translation went away
reviews.text: Just have Latin prayers not the mass

reviews.title: Interactive Rosary
reviews.text: May I recommend you take a picture of a better rosary so your dots land on the exact spot, especially between decades and conclusion.
